subject.title: refactor(talk): add realtime voice session harness and adopt in google-meet and voice-call

question: Should this broad realtime session harness become a documented public Plugin SDK contract now, before the planned Discord adoption validates the same abstraction?
rationale: The bundled consumers need an SDK boundary, but exporting the complete lifecycle harness also commits OpenClaw to an external API shape whose permanence cannot be inferred from tests or the implementation alone.

options.title: Confirm the public contract
options.body: Accept the harness as the canonical Plugin SDK lifecycle surface after live Meet and voice-call proof confirms behavior preservation.

options.title: Keep the surface bundled-only
options.body: Use a narrower bundled-plugin facade until Discord adoption establishes that the abstraction is genuinely transport-independent.

options.title: Defer the consolidation phase
options.body: Pause this PR and retain the existing local wiring until the shared API and adoption sequence are agreed.

recommendation.title: Confirm the public contract
recommendation.body: Accept the harness as the canonical Plugin SDK lifecycle surface after live Meet and voice-call proof confirms behavior preservation.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior merged consolidation phases and this proposed API boundary are connected to steipete's recent work across every affected runtime.
